company.description: Guac is a saving app designed to help the user to save while spending towards their goals. Guac users set their goals, deadlines when they want to purchase/book that goal and utilize Guac's unique percentage-based save while they spend savings tools to fund each goal. Guac users utilize the Guac marketplace to purchase their goals and receive cashback.
